node.title: Optimize a perl block
node.author: IruP
node.doctext:
2017-10-07 Note added by [Athanasius]: This node was copied from [https://codereview.stackexchange.com/|StackExchange]. See also [id://1198857].

hello perlmonks. I would like to optimize the following code: foreach my $a (@{ $array_ref }) { my $i = 0; foreach my $b (split('-', $a)) { foreach my $c (keys %{ $hash_ref }) { $i += $foo->{$b}->{$c}->{'value'}; } } push @{ $bar->{$i} }, $a; }

This loop take lots of time (about 30s on my server) because array_ref contains few millions of entries, it is not a memory problem but only CPU.

The split function returns only five elements and hash_ref is small (10 keys).

What changes I can do to run it faster !
